name: energy-overlay
description: The energy readout a server sends as a raw amount and the client words (MessageEnergyOverlay, #258): a wrench click on a Creative Engine steps its output and puts the new figure over the hotbar. One engine on a small platform, three clicks, a shot after each of the last two; the rig is taken down again.

steps.label: wrench click: the output steps up

steps.name: overlay-second-click
steps.look: a line of text over the hotbar says what the engine was switched to: a number, an energy unit and a rate (per tick or per second, by the client's setting); not a raw translation key, not blank

steps.name: overlay-third-click
steps.look: the same line with a larger number than the shot before
